summary: SCIM request reader enforces its 64 KiB limit while streaming, returning 413 early; plus spec notes and tests.

statements.why: Hardening only; SCIM routes still bearer-token protected.

misses.what: The only code change (app/modules/scim/api.py) isn't mentioned: SCIM writes now reject >64 KiB bodies as soon as the limit is crossed instead of buffering up to the 32 MiB cap.
